notes: Measured model: inside the lens, pixel centre p shows the layer at Center + (p - Center)*100/Magnification, bilinear on premultiplied pixels (bit-exact). Lens = circle of radius Size or square of half-side Size; mask = smoothstep over the signed distance in [-h, +h], h = Feather + 0.72 px (one constant fits Feather 0 antialiasing and Feather 10); the square is a rounded square (SDF of a box of half-side Size - h, inflated by h) — measured on the feathered corner. Normal (Blending Mode 2) = mix(layer, magnified, mask * Opacity/100). Link (AE 4) has no effect on renders (Size 80, Magnification 300, Link 2 gives an 80 px lens): it only couples AE's sliders. Blending Mode popup from AE's dictionary: 1 None, 2 Normal, 3 (-, 4 Add, 5 Multiply, 6 Screen, 7 Overlay, 8 Soft Light, 9 Hard Light, 10 (-, 11 Color Dodge, 12 Color Burn, 13 (-, 14 Darken, 15 Lighten, 16 Difference, 17 Exclusion, 18 (-, 19 Hue, 20 Saturation, 21 Color, 22 Luminosity; only Normal is measured, the others use W3C formulas (lens over layer, faded by the mask), None = the lens alone — unverified. Opacity is applied as a mask multiplier (unmeasured). Not reproduced: Scaling Soft/Scatter (AE 8), Resize Layer (AE 10). Residual max 4 levels on the circle's antialiased rim.
